observations.body: Jesus explains his movement to other cities by saying that he must proclaim God’s Kingdom.
observations.label: Sent to announce God’s Kingdom

observations.body: The passage places God’s Kingdom beside sent to announce god’s kingdom.
observations.label: God’s Kingdom

payload.posture: Read Luke 4:41–44 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states jesus explains his movement to other cities by saying that he must proclaim God’s Kingdom. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
payload.title: Sent to announce God’s Kingdom
